candidate.architecture: Frozen final 256-dimensional query embedding, one linear correction to the frozen person logit
candidate.training: Existing train images and new Town01 pairs only. Fixed L2 penalty 0.015, paired-image weight 4, at most 16 hardest negatives per image.
candidate.eligibility: Frozen person probability at least 0.01, positive box area, person confidence 0.60 after correction. Preserve existing person outputs and suppress additions at IoU >=0.45 to any kept person box.
candidate.primary_metric: Strict one-to-one person IoU >=0.50 using the frozen visible-support eligibility rules

screen.new_validation: At least one more pedestrian TP with no rider TP loss
screen.archive_validation: No pedestrian or rider TP loss
screen.both_validation_sets: Per set, person FP increase <= floor(frames * 0.01) and person precision >=0.85
screen.if_pass: Check full six-class protocol on existing development site and independently validate a frozen export before opening a fresh holdout.
screen.if_fail: Reject this candidate and retain the parent and unopened fresh holdout.
